text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Government drawing up plans for development of national parks.
- Prime Minister Alfred Sant, referring to opposition's decision to lift pairing arrangements, says government will not submit to threats and that government business will not be interrupted.
- Three Libyans arrested in drugs raid.

- Opposition leader says parliamentary debate on motion to amend existing law on Value Added Tax, rather than replace system as planned by government, should continue. The debate, on a private member's motion, was cut short on Thursday on a technical point but led to opposition withdrawing pairing arrangements because of government action on debate.
